name: Deputy Feldon
summary: Deputy Feldon is a member of the Redridge town guard stationed just south of the Great Lakeshire Bridge. Tasked with watching the primary road into Lakeshire, he keeps a nervous vigil against the aggressive gnoll packs creeping toward the town perimeter.

sections.title: A Guard on Edge
sections.body: Standing watch near the southern approach to the Lakeshire bridge, Deputy Feldon represents an overextended town guard fighting to keep basic trade and travel routes open. With the Blackrock orcs pressing from the north and gnoll packs overrunning the southern hills, guardsmen like Feldon are stretched to their limits. Unable to leave his post without compromising the town's perimeter, he relies on passing adventurers to cull the gnolls encroaching on the roadway before they can cut Lakeshire off entirely.

faq.answer: Deputy Feldon is an officer of the Lakeshire town guard stationed just south of the bridge connecting the town to the main southern road in Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why is Deputy Feldon worried about gnolls?
faq.answer: Gnoll encampments have been spotted along the road toward Elwynn Forest. Feldon fears they are poised to push into the human homeland itself, so that Lakeshire would no longer be the only town under siege, and the guard is ill-equipped to deal with them.

faq.q: Why doesn't Feldon deal with the gnolls himself?
faq.answer: The Lakeshire guard is severely understaffed and facing simultaneous threats from orcs and gnolls. Feldon cannot abandon his sentry post at the bridge without leaving the entrance to the town unguarded.

faq.q: Where can Deputy Feldon be found?
faq.answer: He stands watch on the road just south of the Great Lakeshire Bridge, keeping watch over the southern approaches to the town.

angles.text: Feldon embodies the desperate state of Stormwind's outer territories, where local guardsmen must beg passing champions for help maintaining the king's peace.
